description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a compassionate and strategic nursing leader to make a significant impact on resident care and operational excellence.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards. You will play a crucial role in staff development, quality improvement initiatives, and fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff.This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to outstanding healthcare leadership.
requirements: Current and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing.
Demonstrated knowledge of long-term care regulations and best practices.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: The salary for this Director of Nursing (DON) position ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
